description: PRODUCTION Aurora (XPU) SH3 finetune of ProteoScribe (1 block) on the SH3 record JSONL, composing captions on the fly with the PenCL-faithful custom composer (caption_plugins/pencl_caption.py). Bases the 64-node infra config and overrides for a real convergence run: 16 nodes, per-rank batch 16, 500 epochs, identity-controlled split, validate every 20 epochs.
notes: Global batch = batch_size * num_nodes * devices_per_node = 16 * 16 * 12 = 3072. Split search_id0.7 has train=24353 -> ~7-8 optimizer steps/epoch; over 500 epochs ~3800 steps. coswarmup LR schedule spans the full 500 epochs.

scale_learning_rate='sqrt' scales the base lr by sqrt(num_nodes * devices_per_node) = sqrt(192) ~= 13.86, so effective lr ~= 1e-4 * 13.86 = 1.39e-3 (a large-batch-Adam heuristic; 'linear' would give 1.92e-2 which is too high). Treat as a principled starting point, not a validated value.

Caption composition uses the external plugin pencl_caption (compose_plugins below). It reproduces PenCL's caption distribution: KEY: value in fixed canonical order (PROTEIN NAME first), LINEAGE -> 'The organism lineage is ...', family_name/family_description fused into 'FAMILY NAMES: Family names are ...', out-of-vocab labels (GENE ONTOLOGY etc.) dropped by whitelist, and max_item_chars=585 drops over-length field values so long captions cannot truncate the tail (LINEAGE / FAMILY NAMES) past the 512-token text encoder budget.
Reproducible 70/20/10 split via split_manifest_path (identity threshold <=0.7); valid_size is ignored when a manifest is supplied. The manifest fingerprint (n34918-...) is tied to this exact JSONL.
training_strategy=primary_only keeps validation epoch-based; check_val_every_n_epoch=20 so validation runs ~25 times over the run. val_check_interval is ignored in this mode.

weights/ and data/ paths are repo-relative symlinks; on Aurora they must resolve to /flare/NLDesignProtein/sharepoint/BioM3-data-share (re-run the link script and verify run1_base_{proteoscribe,pencl,facilitator} resolve before submitting).
Aurora XPU has shown a first-validation hang on larger datasets (see project_aurora_val_hang); if the run stalls entering validation, reduce node count or limit_val_batches.
